Snoredex — documented Snorlax TCG printings

An auditable catalogue of physical Snorlax Pokémon TCG printings: variants, editions, languages, finishes, foil patterns, stamps, distribution and card size. Verified printings carry positive evidence; marketplace candidates and unresolved claims remain explicitly separate.

What this is

This view projects the historical Cardmarket candidate universe frozen as cardmarket-search-2026-07-21, plus its verification layer. It is not a complete all-locality catalogue. For each legacy claim it answers a narrower question: does a source outside Cardmarket confirm this printing actually exists?

Scope limits — read these before relying on anything here.
  • Physical cards only. Code cards are excluded. Language and finish evidence are separate; a language confirmation never establishes a finish.
  • Pending means unresolved, never absent. Missing source entries are gaps. Only an explicit collection-owner adjudication settles absence; otherwise contradictions remain disputed.
  • Every “Spanish” row in this legacy table is European Spanish. LATAM (es-419) is a separate physical edition in the locality graph, never implied by European Spanish (es-ES) or a Cardmarket filter.
  • Evidence must reach the exact card. 6 claims remain needs-evidence and do not enter the chronological table or canonical checklist.

Artwork & detection review

This client-side review surface reads the generated projection of the authoritative locality graph. It keeps an automatically derived image group separate from each physical local release, shows the current catalogue-derived detection fields beside the recorded image and evidence, and emits downloadable review proposals. These image groups are suggestions only; a reviewed artwork identity is assigned only by an explicit human decision. It never writes the catalogue from the browser.

Review boundary. Proposals carry stable graph IDs, before-values, source observation hashes and the projection version. A reviewed import must validate them against the current graph before any generator can change catalogue truth. The projection currently covers 633 card releases in 249 automatic image groups plus 2 unmapped source-first releases; no reviewed artwork appearances are materialized here. Download the projection.

Artwork review data is loaded only when requested, so the normal collection view stays light.

Help correct this

Use the row’s Correction? link to report positive evidence for that printing. A missing source entry is not proof of absence; pending means unresolved, never unavailable. Contribution guide · Evidence ladder · Open questions

Sources

6551 claims are attributed across 1659 distinct sources (1651 unique URLs and 8 non-URL evidence classes). Providers confirm only what they name; omission never establishes absence.
